SELECT
    ProductKey,
    ProductName,
    BrandName,
    ProductDescription,
    ClassName,
    ColorName,
    UnitPrice,
    UnitCost,
    Status
FROM retail.DimProduct
WHERE BrandName = 'Contoso'
ORDER BY ProductName
